title: Collaborative In-Context Learning for Indoor Radio Map Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Indoor radio map estimation (RME) is essential for wireless applications such as coverage planning, localization, and network deployment. However, most existing methods follow a supervised learning paradigm that requires costly labeled data and task-specific model training. Moreover, indoor environments involve privacy-sensitive information, such as building layouts and structures, that often cannot be centralized. To address these challenges, we make the first attempt to formulate indoor RME as a collaborative in-context learning (ICL) problem. We propose Poly-Ripple, a framework in which multiple clients perform ICL using large autoregressive vision models (LAVMs) without model updates. Each client is prompted by its private demonstrations and predicts the radio map for the same scene query. translated_title: 面向室内无线电地图估计的协作式上下文学习
translated_abstract: 室内无线电地图估计（RME）对于覆盖规划、定位和网络部署等无线应用至关重要。然而，现有的大多数方法遵循监督学习范式，需要昂贵的标注数据和针对特定任务的模型训练。此外，室内环境涉及隐私敏感信息，例如建筑布局和结构，这些信息通常无法集中收集。为应对这些挑战，我们首次尝试将室内无线电地图估计形式化为一个协作式上下文学习（ICL）问题。我们提出了Poly-Ripple框架，其中多个客户端使用大型自回归视觉模型（LAVM）执行上下文学习，而无需进行模型更新。每个客户端由其私有的示例进行提示，并针对相同的场景查询预测无线电地图。为了捕捉无线信号从发射机（Tx）向外传播的因果结构，我们采用了波纹序自回归建模方法。
tldr: 提出Poly-Ripple框架，首次将室内无线电地图估计形式化为协作式上下文学习问题，使多个客户端利用大型自回归视觉模型和波纹序自回归建模，在无需模型更新并保护隐私的前提下协作预测无线电地图。
en_tdlr: Proposes Poly-Ripple, the first framework to formulate indoor radio map estimation as collaborative in-context learning, where multiple clients leverage large autoregressive vision models with ripple-ordered autoregressive modeling to predict radio maps collaboratively without model updates while preserving privacy.
